issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare Course.getAverageRating() to return Double, but the solution implementation returns Float. This return-type mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about the expected API and may cause type errors or failing checks if tests expect a Double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Prefer aligning the solution with the problem/template by changing the solution's getAverageRating() signature to return Double and perform calculations using Double (e.g. return Double(starSum) / Double(totalRatings) or cast the result to Double). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to use Float if that was intentional.
